column1: # OWASP ZAP rule configuration for .github/workflows/zap-scan.yml (docs/SECURITY-SCAN.md).
# One rule per line, TAB-separated: <rule id>
# Rules not listed keep ZAP's default (WARN). The workflow doesn't fail on WARN; set a rule to FAIL to make the run
# fail when ZAP finds it. Rule ids are in each alert of the report (and at https://www.zaproxy.org/docs/alerts/).
# Reviewed 2026-10-06 against the first scan; each IGNORE says why it doesn't apply to this app.
# The app's job is to show the ASIAIR's LAN address and the capture times of frames:
# Frame names, checksums and job ids look like Base64 to ZAP; nothing secret is encoded:
# Words like "TODO" or "user" in app.js comments and strings; reviewed, nothing sensitive:
# Sec-Fetch-* are request headers browsers send; ZAP's own requests lack them. Nothing for the app to fix:
# 400/404/422 answers to ZAP's attack payloads are the app correctly refusing them (counts only, no data):

column1: # The API scan expects JSON from GET /; that's the HTML page, by design:
# Plain HTTP on the runner; in use, HTTPS comes from Nginx Proxy Manager in front (docs/DEPLOY.md):
# Informational, describe the app rather than a weakness:
# Spring4Shell is a Java/Spring bug; this app is Python. Flagged once (2026-10-06) because POST /api/copy/run
# answered 400 to the payload but 409 ("a run is in progress") to ZAP's baseline request:
# Kept at WARN on purpose:
# 43 (Source Code Disclosure - File Inclusion) was a false positive on /api/preview?rel= and POST /api/answers
# (they answered 400/404 and returned no file content), but it's the rule that would catch a real path bug there.
# 40018 (SQL Injection), second scan, on POST /api/cleanup/verify (method) and /api/devices/connect|select (host):
# a false positive. Those values are checked against fixed lists / parsed as IP addresses and never reach SQL (every
# query in db.py uses bound parameters); the "different results" were 409 vs 400 answers as ZAP's own requests
# started and finished jobs. Kept because it's the rule that would catch a real injection.
